summary: One segment: a radio drawn as part of the track, with an optional icon.
useWhen: inside a SegmentedControl, once per option

children.note: one or two words. Segments do not wrap, and a long label truncates

icon.note: decorative beside a label; with no label, pass aria-label

requires: `aria-label` when the segment has an icon and no text — the accessible name otherwise comes from its children

antiPatterns.why: it reads its selection state from the group, and throws without one
